entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We did all we can, right?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: All we need to do now is[n]await the results.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I wonder what's gonna happen when[n]he has the change of heart. Do[n]you think he'll turn himself in?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: That seems likely.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I hope he spills everything[n]to the police...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Well, there are still a few[n]lingering worries, but I[n]believe we did well.
We did.
Not well enough.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Right? We were going up against[n]a real criminal, after all.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: C'mon, it wouldn't hurt to pat[n]ourselves on the back for once.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Yes. We managed to steal the[n]heart of a notable lawbreaker.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I can't wait to see Akechi's[n]face when he hears the news!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Honestly, I just hope that[n]people who see it get some[n]courage from the news.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: There's still one thing[n]that worries me though...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Do you mean how someone is[n]using the Metaverse for evil?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: It would be seriously[n]unforgivable if someone[n]was really doing that...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Eh, we can think[n]about that later.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: For now, let's just wait for[n]Kaneshiro's change of heart.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Very well. Nicely done, everyone!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: All we need to do now is let the results[n]come rolling in.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: We did great today though! Public[n]opinion of us should skyrocket after this!
